A uniform (+q,+q,+q) sums to +3q. It also contradicts the block's own mechanism two items earlier, where sigma_1's swap comes from opposite rates whose difference accumulates a phase of pi with the centre of mass conserved. Concatenating the letters gives the witness value exactly: (+q,-q,0) then (0,+q,-q) averages over 2 sub-intervals to (0.5, 0, -0.5), and the witness records n_sub_intervals = 2. The two 3-cycles differ by the ORDER of the sub-intervals, not by an overall sign. (2) S_3 DOES NOT EMBED IN SU(2): 'This explicitly constructs the S_3 holonomy of rho: B_3 -> SU(2)'. SU(2) has a unique element of order 2, namely -I, since g^2 = I with det g = 1 forces both eigenvalues +1 or both -1; S_3 has three involutions. PROPOSED: rho: B_3 -> SO(3) = PSU(2), where S_3 = D_3 does sit, or state it as a projective representation.
